== Summary ==
Players Committee full-face virtual-card image for [[Lak Sivrak (Errata 2)]], based on [[Shistavanen Wolfman]]. Exact source PNG: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/44c7bc5c258703260424a3793cd55f0221d672e4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/hires/laksivrak.png Holotable commit 44c7bc5c], authored and committed 2022-07-10T17:26:49Z. The selected Wiki GIF has identical complete decoded RGB pixels and dimensions to that PNG, although its encoded file bytes differ. The source retains the printed underlying Decipher copyright line; this virtual remake is published by the Players Committee. This description changes no image bytes.
